rules.question: Under which settings is a chart analyzed (its profile)?
must_match: store::ResultSettings filed_under() const { return {chartmode, cap_query(), lens}; }
rules.note: A profile (chartmode, SP cap and lens) put together by hand instead of through Settings::profile or its two named variants, profile_at_clone_hero_cap and profile_with_fills. While Settings::record_key exists it holds the one assembly of the three parts and rules/store/concept-H1.json guards it, so this row has no owner line yet; when record_key goes, the assembly moves into Settings::profile and gets its owner line here. The scope is all of src because the scan scopes by top folder or single file; today's hits are all in src/app and src/ui. The hand-built ones that stand today are listed in baseline.json until the D115 A2 tasks move them. Decided by: D115, plan docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-12-one-record-per-chart.md, task A1-4.
